action: Execute the under-$22K floor strategy with real discipline this month: pull every unit priced under $22K to the front of the lot, build a targeted pitch around total monthly cost (not sticker), and personally call five pre-qualified leads from the past 90 days who were shopping in that range but did not close. This is not outreach for the sake of activity — I am trying to close at least one unit before the end of the month to stop the savings bleed.
